$$

x - 2 \neq 0 \quad \Rightarrow \quad x \neq 2
$$

$$

To find the matrix that projects a vector onto the $ y $-axis, we need to understand the concept of a projection matrix. A projection matrix is a matrix that, when multiplied by a vector, produces the projection of that vector onto a subspace. In this case, we are projecting onto the $ y $-axis, which is a one-dimensional subspace in the plane.

The $ y $-axis can be represented by the vector $ \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix} $. To find the projection matrix onto this vector, we can use the formula for the projection matrix onto a vector $ \mathbf{a} $:

$$
\mathbf{P} = \frac{\mathbf{a} \mathbf{a}^T}{\mathbf{a}^T \mathbf{a}}
$$

Substituting $ \mathbf{a} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix} $, we get:

$$
\mathbf{a} \mathbf{a}^T = \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}
$$

$$
\mathbf{a}^T \mathbf{a} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix} = 1
$$

Therefore, the projection matrix is:

$$
\mathbf{P} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}
$$

This matrix, when multiplied by any vector $ \begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \end{bmatrix} $, will produce the projection of that vector onto the $ y $-axis, which is $ \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ y \end{bmatrix} $. Therefore, the matrix that projects onto the $ y $-axis is $ \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} $.

- $ E = (x_E, y_E) $
- $ G = (x_G, y_G) $

We want $ 3a $ to be divisible by 9, i.e.:

$$

- $ a = 3 \Rightarrow 333 $
- $ a = 6 \Rightarrow 666 $
- $ a = 9 \Rightarrow 999 $

### Step 4: Determine the smallest such number

$$
\boxed{333}
$$

\boxed{333}
